# nxos_macsec (Data Source)

This data source can read the MACsec configuration on NX-OS devices, including MACsec policies and per-interface MACsec keychain and policy settings.

### API Documentation

- [macsecEntity](https://pubhub.devnetcloud.com/media/dme-docs-10-5-3/docs/Security%20and%20Policing/macsec:Entity/)
- [macsecInst](https://pubhub.devnetcloud.com/media/dme-docs-10-5-3/docs/Security%20and%20Policing/macsec:Inst/)
- [macsecPolicy](https://pubhub.devnetcloud.com/media/dme-docs-10-5-3/docs/Security%20and%20Policing/macsec:Policy/)
- [macsecIf](https://pubhub.devnetcloud.com/media/dme-docs-10-5-3/docs/Security%20and%20Policing/macsec:If/)

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nxos_macsec" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The distinguished name of the object.
- `interfaces` (Attributes Map) List of MACsec interfaces.
  - Map key: `interface_id` - Must match first field in the output of `show intf brief`. Example: `eth1/1`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--interfaces))
- `policies` (Attributes Map) List of MACsec policies.
  - Map key: `name` - Name of Macsec Policy. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--policies))
- `shutdown` (Boolean) Enable or disable Macsec Shutdown.

<a id="nestedatt--interfaces"></a>
### Nested Schema for `interfaces`

Read-Only:

- `fallback_keychain_name` (String) Name of Macsec Fallback Key Chain.
- `keychain_name` (String) Name of Macsec Key Chain.
- `keychain_pki` (Boolean) Name of Macsec Keychain-Pki-Mode.
- `policy_name` (String) Name of Macsec Policy.


<a id="nestedatt--policies"></a>
### Nested Schema for `policies`

Read-Only:

- `allowed_peer_cipher_suite_1` (String) Cipher Suite for Macsec Policy.
- `allowed_peer_cipher_suite_2` (String) Cipher Suite for Macsec Policy.
- `allowed_peer_cipher_suite_3` (String) Cipher Suite for Macsec Policy.
- `allowed_peer_cipher_suite_4` (String) Cipher Suite for Macsec Policy.
- `cipher_suite` (String) Cipher Suite for Macsec Policy.
- `confidentiality_offset` (String) Confidentiality Offset for Macsec Policy.
- `crypto_policy_name` (String) Name of Crypto Profile Policy.
- `include_icv_indicator` (Boolean) Include ICV Indicator paramset in MKPDU for Macsec Policy.
- `include_sci` (Boolean) Include SCI in sectag for Macsec Policy.
- `key_server_priority` (Number) Key Server Priority for Macsec Policy.
- `lldp_bypass` (Boolean) bypass lldp protocol packet.
- `replay_window` (Number) Replay Window for Macsec Policy.
- `sak_expiry_time` (String) Security Association Key Expiry Time for Macsec Policy.
- `security_policy` (String) Security Policy for Macsec Policy.
